description: SOC-thermal voltage model: V = OCV(SOC) - I*R(T), with Arrhenius resistance and capacity correction

cell.name: A123 ANR26650M1B (LFP)
cell.source: Chen et al. (2020), J. Electrochem. Soc., 167, 080534; A123 datasheet

ocv_coefficients.description: OCV(SOC) polynomial fit for LFP -- characteristically flat plateau ~3.3V
ocv_coefficients.source: Fitted to LFP OCV data from Chen et al. (2020) and A123 discharge curves

E_a.note: Activation energy for internal resistance (LFP less temp-sensitive)
E_a.source: Ecker et al. (2015), J. Electrochem. Soc., 162(9), A1836-A1848; Thomas et al. (2008)

alpha_c.note: Linear capacity temperature coefficient (LFP less sensitive)
alpha_c.source: Gallagher et al. (2014), J. Electrochem. Soc., 161(3), A403-A410

dOCV_dT.note: Entropic coefficient (LFP has smaller entropy change)
dOCV_dT.source: Forgez et al. (2010), J. Power Sources, 195(9), 2961-2968
